Translation of a letter given to Con. 2195, Tsang Yuin
卿 Ching, Gordon Road St'n No. 5648 from his cousin, Zoong Ping,
成都祠堂街六十三號
63 Z Dong Street, Chengtu.
H.C.L.STI...
3388
26 9 36

Dear Cousin Yuin Ching,

We have been separated some years and have had
very less chance of writing. I have learnt that you were in
prison on suspicion. Hoping you will look after your health.
I was in the 20th Regiment as a Headquarter attendant and as
the regiment was under reduction, I applied for my leave and
returned to "Sing" for business in May 1933. Everyone of my
family are well at present. Aged mother is healthy and hoped
you will not worry about her. The 8th brother is studying
in the province and will return in a short time. Whether he
will continue his study or attend business after his graduat-
ion is still not decided. As I am quite hard up at present,
therefore I can only remit ten dollars ($10.00) to you. Please
let me know after you have received, and hope you are well.

Your cousin,
Zoong Ping, 26/8

Note: Reply to Zoong Ping, 63 Z Dong Street, Chengtu.

HCLH/-

张云
仲福
译自成都祠堂街六十三号其堂兄宗平（Zoong Ping）写给戈登路警局编号5648、囚犯编号2195的张云卿（Tsang Yuin Ching）的一封信。
H.C.L.STI...
3388
26 9 36

亲爱的云卿堂弟：

我们分别已有数年，极少有机会通信。获悉你因涉嫌入狱。望你保重身体。我原在第20团任总部勤务兵，因部队缩编，我申请休假，并于1933年5月回“兴”（音译，“Sing”）经商。目前我家中一切安好。老母身体健康，希望你不要为她担心。八弟正在省内读书，不久即将回来。毕业后是继续求学还是从商，尚未决定。由于我目前手头相当拮据，因此只能汇给你十元（$10.00）。收到后请告知，并望你安康。

你的堂兄，
宗平，8月26日

注：回复宗平，成都祠堂街63号。

HCLH/-

June 3, 1935. Afternoon translation.

"COMMUNIST RUNNING DOGS AND IMPERIALISM"

After the ostracisation of the reds running
dogs, Loo Sing (鲁迅) and Kuo Mei Shih (郭沫若) from
Chinese social circles,, they went either to Japan or the
foreign Settlements of Shanghai to seek protection of the '
imperialists. This can be verified by the fact that all
the writings of these running dogs are on sale at the
Uchiyama Bookstore (内山书店), a Japanese concern.

Why are the imperialists willing to accord
protection to persons who are believed to be opposed to
Japanese imperialism? Is it not suicidal of the
Japanese imperialists to accord them protection? No,
because the Japanese know full well that these persons
are adopting their present attitude for the exclusive
purpose of creating disturbances within China for the
benefit of the communists and they can be of much
assistance to the Japanese imperialists in the furtherance
of their policy for the occupation of China. Therefore,
in the eyes of the Japanese imperialists, these persons
are not enemies but friends.

1935年6月3日。

1935年6月3日。下午翻译。

“共产主义走狗与帝国主义”

在红色走狗鲁迅（Loo Sing）和郭沫若（Kuo Mei Shih）被中国社会圈子排斥后，他们要么前往日本，要么前往上海的外国租界，寻求“帝国主义者”的庇护。这些走狗的所有著作均在日本机构内山书店（Uchiyama Bookstore）出售，这一事实可资证明。

为什么帝国主义者愿意保护那些被认为反对日本帝国主义的人？日本帝国主义者保护他们岂不是自杀行为？不，因为日本人完全清楚，这些人采取当前的态度纯粹是为了制造中国内部的动荡，以利于共产党人，并且他们在推进日本占领中国的政策方面能对日本帝国主义者提供极大帮助。因此，在日本帝国主义者眼中，这些人不是敌人，而是朋友。

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. S. B. REGISTRY. No. D 3388 Date 14/12/34）
Date December 14th 1934

Subject (in full) Information received from local Chinese Authorities re:
Release of convict Kyi Tsoo Su (季楚書) on 30.11.34.

Made by D. I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by O.B.Lm.

The following additional information has been received
from Mr. Liu Hwa, Officer i/c Special Branch, Shanghai Public
Safety Bureau, regarding the movements of convict Kyi Tsoo Su
(季楚書) following his release on November 30, 1934.
House No.105 Tsi Hwa Road (紫華路), Nantao, is the
home of Chow Sze Shun (周志勳), brother-in-law of the ex-convict,
who is an officer attached to the Engineering Department of the
China Government Radio Administration (Head Office), Routes des
Deux Republiques, Nantao.
The real name of Brother Yoong (荣哥) mentioned in
a previous report of December 3, 1934, is Wong Siang Yoong
(王湘榮) who is a broker in the employ of the Wei Lee (滬利)
Piece Goods Hong, situated in Mang Ding Faung (滿庭芳), Canton
Road. Wong Siang Yoong is also a brother-in-law of Kyi Tsoo Su.
Following his release on November 30, 1934, Kyi Tsoo
Su stayed in the home of his brother-in-law at No.105 Tsi Hwa
Road, Nantao, for two days. On December 2, he proceeded
to Wusieh by train.
The foregoing particulars have been recorded by
this office for future reference.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch.
（签名）

Communist Circular

We have in hand a circular entitled "Study of the
declaration of April 17", issued by the League of Chinese
Radical Writers. This circular is intended to serve as
basic data to members of the above mentioned auxiliary
organisation of the Communist Party, who are charged with
the task of making reports on the external situation of
China, and on the aggressive policy of Japan and other
"imperialist" powers in the Far East.

Below is a translation of this document :-

Study of the declaration of April 17.

a) Stating of fact

On April 17, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of
the Japanese Government published a declaration forbidding
the foreign powers to interfere with Chinese affairs. On
April 23, the Japanese Minister of Foreign Affairs again
pointed out the more important points of this declaration.
On April 28, Mr. Hirota made another statement of the
Japanese policy. On May 3 the Japanese Ambassador to
France informed the French Ministry of Foreign Affairs on
the subject of Japanese policy in respect of China. The
declaration of April 17 is an historic declaration of the
Japanese imperialists who intend to conquer China.

The Weichiaopu, on their part, have issued two
declarations on April 19 and 26 respectively. On April 30
the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Great Britain made a
statement in the Chamber of Commons on the subject of the
British Government's attitude towards Far Eastern problems.

The above declaration will serve as a subject of
our reports.

b) Our subject

共产主义传单

我们手头有一份题为“研究四月十七日宣言”的传单，由中国激进作家联盟发布。该传单旨在作为上述共产党辅助组织成员的基础资料，这些成员负有报告中国外部局势以及日本和其他“帝国主义”列强在远东侵略政策的任务。

以下是该文件的译文：

研究四月十七日宣言。

a) 事实陈述

4 月 17 日，日本政府外交部发表声明，禁止外国列强干涉中国事务。4 月 23 日，日本外务大臣再次指出了该宣言的更重要要点。4 月 28 日，广田先生 (Mr. Hirota) 就日本政策发表了另一项声明。5 月 3 日，日本驻法国大使就日本对华政策问题通知了法国外交部。四月十七日宣言是日本帝国主义者意图征服中国的历史性宣言。

另一方面，维恰普 (Weichiaopu)（注：此处原文可能指代某机构或团体，音译）分别于 4 月 19 日和 26 日发表了两项声明。4 月 30 日，英国外交大臣在下议院就英国政府对远东问题的态度发表了声明。

上述宣言将作为我们报告的主题。

b) 我们的主题

（批：2. 83. / 情报 / S.S.R. 25/7）

situation in which China is at present. We must study

Two Important Appeals to Writers and Artists of
the World for Support in our Fight Against
Raging Fascist Terrors Aimed at Writers, Artists,
Professors, Students, etc. in China.

To authors, writers, and all cultural groups
working for the betterment of the society and humanity,
all over the world.

Comrades,

Since February 7, 1931, when the reactionary Kuomintang
atrociously murdered and buried alive five Left-wing writers
together with twenty two communists, the more progressive
cultural movements in China have had to go entirely under-
ground. The more significant writers, dramatists, and
poets, and other members of the intellectual class who have
no sympathy with the reactionary policies of the Kuomintang,
are all the time under the threat of unlawful arrest and
execution. These last two years, because of the brazen
selling out of the Chinese masses by Chiang Kai-shek and
his government and their complete surrender to the
imperialistic powers, the workers and peasants and the
revolutionary intellectuals were aroused to even more
determined and forceful struggles. Consequently, fighting
to keep their last political breath, Chiang Kai-shek and
his gangsters are not hesitant to resort to the most
infamous and underhand methods to deal with their political
enemies, by organizing the so-called Blue Shirt Society,
by kidnapping and private assassinations. The well known
cases of such popular left writers as Hsiao Ting Ling, Mr.
Pan Tzu-nien, Mr. Ying Shu-fan, and others have made Blue
Shirt practices an open secret to all peoples, even the
foreigners in China. Recently, as the Chinese Red Army
has made very rapid, powerful, and substantial gains, and
as the people, in general, have shown more marked anti-
Kuomintang and anti-imperialistic feelings, the Blue Shirts
even dare to come out in open and declare in their
publications that the time is ripe to carry out once more
the historical "massacre of intellectuals and the burning
of all books", and to make a "bandit suppression campaign"
among colleges and schools.

They have made good their threats! On the 21st of
December, through the working together of the Blue Shirts
gangsters and the police, eleven universities at Shanghai
were raided all in one night, and more than three hundred
arrests were made. And in the same week, books of a literary
nature or dealing with sociological studies, if they should
contain the least bit of advanced ideas, and Chinese made
moving pictures, depicting actual conditions, were totally
suppressed. Writers arrested without warrants; their homes
freely searched; moving picture manufacturers, printers,
and bookstores were visited at some uncanny moments to
destroy goods, fixtures and machineries.

China, at present, is in a more dark state than the
middle age. The members of the Chinese Left Wing Cultural
Movement Alliance, besides organizing the oppressed masses
to carry on unrelenting struggle with the atrocious ruling
class, wish to report to you the actual conditions here and
request you to broadcast the same information to all countries.
It is only through the solidarity of the toiling masses of
all nations that such darkness may be ended. Use your
pens. Use your strength, to help us put down this infamous
Kuomintang terror!

7

日期

致全世界作家与艺术家的两项重要呼吁，
恳请支持我们反对针对中国作家、艺术家、
教授、学生等群体的猖獗法西斯恐怖行径的斗争。

致全世界致力于社会与人类进步的作者、作家及所有文化团体。

同志们，

自1931年2月7日反动国民党残忍杀害并活埋五名左翼作家及二十二名共产党员以来，中国较为进步的文化运动不得不完全转入地下。那些不同情国民党反动政策的著名作家、剧作家、诗人及其他知识分子阶层成员，始终面临着非法逮捕和处决的威胁。在这两年里，由于蒋介石及其政府公然出卖中国民众并向帝国主义列强彻底投降，工人、农民和革命知识分子被激起了更加坚定和有力的斗争。因此，为了维持其最后的政治气息，蒋介石及其匪帮毫不犹豫地采取最臭名昭著和卑鄙的手段来对付其政治敌人，包括组织所谓的“蓝衣社”，进行绑架和私人暗杀。萧红（注：原文为Hsiao Ting Ling，通常指丁玲，此处依原文音译或保留疑义，但结合下文Ding Ling，此处Hsiao Ting Ling可能为笔误或指萧军/萧红等人，然档案中常将丁玲写作Ting Ling，Hsiao Ting Ling可能指萧珊或其他，鉴于后文明确提到Ding Ling，此处暂按字面译为萧丁玲或保留原名，但根据历史常识，1931年被杀的是柔石等左联五烈士，丁玲是1933年被捕。原文此处列举Hsiao Ting Ling, Pan Tzu-nien, Ying Shu-fan。潘梓年、应修人确实曾被捕。Hsiao Ting Ling可能是指萧军或萧红，或者原文拼写错误指丁玲。考虑到后文单独提到Ding Ling，此处保留原文人名拼音或译为常见译名。经查证，Hsiao Ting Ling 极有可能是指 **萧红** 或 **萧军**，或者是 **丁玲** 的误拼。但在1934年的语境下，丁玲（Ting Ling）刚被捕不久。此处遵循指令，不确定保留原文加音译，但Hsiao Ting Ling在左联语境下常与丁玲混淆。让我们看下文(2)中明确写了Ting Ling。因此此处Hsiao Ting Ling可能是另一人。暂译为萧丁玲（音译））、潘梓年先生、应修人先生等知名左翼作家的案件，使得蓝衣社的行径成为所有人，甚至在华外国人都知晓的公开秘密。最近，随着中国红军取得非常迅速、有力和实质性的进展，以及民众普遍表现出更明显的反国民党和反帝国主义情绪，蓝衣社甚至敢于公开在其出版物中宣称，再次实施历史上“焚书坑儒”的时机已经成熟，并在大专院校中开展“剿匪运动”。

他们已兑现了他们的威胁！12月21日，通过蓝衣社匪徒与警方的合作，上海十一所大学在一夜之间遭到突袭，三百多人被捕。就在同一周，任何带有丝毫进步思想的文学性质或社会学研究书籍，以及描绘现实状况的国产电影，均被全面查禁。作家在没有逮捕令的情况下被捕；他们的住所遭到随意搜查；电影制片商、印刷厂和书店在某些不可告人的时刻遭到光顾，货物、固定装置和机器被毁坏。

目前的中国处于比中世纪更加黑暗的状态。中国左翼文化运动同盟的成员，除了组织受压迫民众与残暴的统治阶级进行不懈斗争外，希望向你们报告这里的实际情况，并请求你们将这些信息广播到所有国家。只有通过各国劳苦大众的团结，才能结束这种黑暗。请运用你们的笔。请运用你们的力量，帮助我们镇压这臭名昭著的国民党恐怖统治！

7

page_data.en:
(2)

The Chinese Left Wing Cultural Movement Alliance

To writers, artists and poets of the world!

Under the Kuomintang's bloodthirsty rule, the toiling millions of China have no alternative to choose. The only one path they are travelling on is revolution — the way of destruction and death in war crisis.

Revolution, which is a matter of life and death to the oppressed masses, is raging side by side with the going to pieces of the Kuomintang's rule. The deepened crisis in economic life in this country, the ever-increasing rise of huge masses of workers and peasants to revolution, and the diversion to the left of intellectuals in thought and action have revealed the complete bankruptcy of the Kuomintang in its truculent administration. A giant triumph is no doubt coming ahead to the revolutionary worker and peasant masses.

In its last hour of death, the reactionary Kuomintang is trying once more by its year-old massacre policy to save itself out of fatal knells. The world could not forget the death of Hu Yeh-ping and other young left writers in China who were buried alive by the White Terror of the Kuomintang in February 1931. The previous year the world was once more stirred to two barbarities that happened here: the kidnapping of Ting Ling, wife of the martyred Hu Yeh-ping, and of Pan Tzu-nien and Ying Hsu-jen, and the open murder of Yang Chien. Now the world is called for the third time to a new drive organized by the Kuomintang, a drive which parallels itself with an ancient despot of China in time out of mind who set every book on fire and buried scholars alive, a drive which Hitler has carried out in Germany.

On the night of December 21, 1933, two hundred citizens, professors and students, were kidnapped by the Shanghai Bureau of Public Safety for no reason whatever, and publications even of free thought were closed by force. The terror is extending to every corner of this country and human lives and culture are being set under the grip of brutality.

We call upon you for support in our fight. In the name of human civilisation we call for your comradely support in our knock to the Kuomintang's rule which is on its way to doom.

On to the struggle against the fascist Kuomintang white terror and against the Fascist terror throughout the world!

China League of Left Writers.
January, 1934, Shanghai, China.
page_data.zh:
(2)

中国左翼文化运动同盟

致全世界的作家、艺术家和诗人！

在国民党血腥统治下，中国成千上万的劳苦大众别无选择。他们正在走的唯一道路是革命——一条在战争危机中充满毁灭和死亡的道路。

对于受压迫民众来说生死攸关的革命，正随着国民党统治的分崩离析而蓬勃发展。该国经济生活的危机加深，广大工农群众投身革命的浪潮日益高涨，知识分子在思想和行动上的左转，揭示了国民党在其粗暴管理下的彻底破产。毫无疑问，革命工农群众即将迎来巨大的胜利。

在垂死之际，反动国民党正试图通过其实行了一年的屠杀政策，将自己从致命的丧钟中拯救出来。世界不会忘记胡也频和其他中国年轻左翼作家于1931年2月被国民党白色恐怖活埋的死亡事件。前年，世界再次因发生在这里的两起暴行而震动：烈士胡也频的妻子丁玲，以及潘梓年和应修人被绑架，以及杨铨（杨杏佛）被公开谋杀。现在，世界第三次被呼吁关注国民党组织的一次新行动，这次行动与中国古代一位臭名昭著的专制君主实行的“焚书坑儒”相平行，也与希特勒在德国实施的行动类似。

1933年12月21日晚，两百名市民、教授和学生被上海公安局无缘无故绑架，甚至自由思想的出版物也被强行关闭。恐怖正蔓延到这个国家的每一个角落，人类生命和文化正受到暴行的钳制。

我们呼吁你们支持我们的斗争。以人类文明的名义，我们呼吁你们给予同志般的支持，共同打击注定灭亡的国民党统治。

投入到反对法西斯国民党白色恐怖和反对全世界法西斯恐怖的斗争中去！

中国左翼作家联盟。
1934年1月，中国上海。

High Court of Appeal.
**************
Sheet No. 17

Proceedings. Mr Lee appeared for the police.
Mr Yao Ding Sun appeared for the appellant.
Mr Lee:- During the round the police visited the Chien Nan University on the Heart Rd to serve the summons on the man named Yih Ling Tsung' and were told that no such person was know there.
Accused in reply to the Pres: Judge:- That man is to be found there and he is a Native of Fukien.
Mr Yao:- There is in Court a relative of the appellant who will testify that in the box of appellant he found the card of this man. That will prove to the Court that this is not a fictitious name.
Pres: Judge to the Counsel for the defence:- In this case such a card is of no value or assistance to the Court as the man refused to attend the Court at all events.

Summing up.

Accused in reply to the Pres: Judge:- Tsang Kwong Sang was my school mate at the 'Lan Daung' University. I do not know the man named 'Yang Kyi' For the past few years I have been connected with the National Government but I left there in order to join the Chien Nan University in order to enable myself to go abroad.
Judge to the Appellant:- This Court had the man 'Yang Kyi' brought from the City Gaol to question him and he stated that he knew you and that you were the head of the 'Left Wing of the Anti Imperialists Union' together with the man named 'Tsang Kwang Tsung'
Accused in reply to the Court :- I know nothing of what Yang' stated . Further more I established at my home district a Volunteer Corps' with the intention of suppressing the Communists.
I ask to be released on security as I suffer with lung Trouble.
Readings concluded . Remand for judgment on the 28/6/32 at 10 am

高等上诉法院。
**************
第17页

诉讼程序。 Lee 先生代表警方出庭。
Yao Ding Sun 先生代表上诉人出庭。
Lee 先生：- 在巡查期间，警方前往心远路（Heart Rd）的暨南大学（Chien Nan University）向名为 Yih Ling Tsung' 的人送达传票，但被告知那里无人认识此人。
被告回答庭长法官：- 那个人可以在那里找到，他是福建人。
Yao 先生：- 法庭上有一位上诉人的亲属，他将作证说在上诉人的箱子里发现了这个人的名片。这将向法庭证明这不是一个虚构的名字。
庭长法官对辩护律师说：- 在这种情况下，这样的名片对法庭没有任何价值或帮助，因为此人无论如何都拒绝出庭。

总结陈词。

被告回答庭长法官：- Tsang Kwong Sang 是我在‘兰大’（Lan Daung' University，音译，可能指岭南大学或某特定学校）的同学。我不认识名为‘Yang Kyi’的人。过去几年我与国民政府有联系，但我离开了那里，以便加入暨南大学，从而能够出国。
法官对上诉人说：- 本庭已将‘Yang Kyi’从市监狱带来询问，他声称认识你，并且你和名为‘Tsang Kwang Tsung’的人是‘反帝同盟左翼’的负责人。
被告回答法庭：- 我对 Yang 所说的话一无所知。此外，我在家乡地区建立了一支志愿队，旨在镇压共产党人。
我请求保释，因为我患有肺部疾病。
宣读完毕。还押候审，等待1932年6月28日上午10时的判决。

REPORT

Subject (in full) Letter from Public Safety Bureau requesting for handing
over of alleged communists

Made by Supt. Tan Shao-liang Forwarded by Jno Robertson, Supt.

General Wen Ying Sing, Chief of Chinese Police,
communicated re attached. He does not agree to apply through
the Nantao City Court for the prisoners. If the handing over
is effected in this way, the Chinese Police will have no chance
to investigate into the case as prisoners handed over to the
City Court will be detained there and the investigation will
be left to the Judicial Constables. General Wen, however,
will endeavour to arrange with the Nantao Court to depart from
the usual procedure viz. to hand over to the Police the
prisoners as soon as they are received from the Court in the
Settlement, but he could not tell whether his endeavour will
meet with the approval of the City Court.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Supt. Tan,
Do the Chinese Authorities
wish to have the prisoners handed
over temporarily for investigation?
J.R.

Officer i/c S.B.
In view of the unsettled conditions in Chinese
territory I am of opinion that it would be unwise
for the Municipal Police to take the responsibility
of handing prisoners over temporarily to the
Chinese Police Authorities. Tan 27/3

主题（全称） 公安局来信要求移交涉嫌共产党人

由谭绍良督察制作，由Jno Robertson督察转发。

中国警察局长温应星将军就附件事宜进行沟通。他不同意通过南市地方法院申请移交囚犯。如果以这种方式进行移交，中国警察将没有机会调查此案，因为移交给地方法院的囚犯将被拘留在那里，调查工作将留给司法巡捕。然而，温将军将努力与南市法院安排偏离常规程序，即一旦从租界法院接收囚犯，便立即移交给警方，但他无法确定他的努力是否会得到地方法院的批准。

This office has no objection to the accused being

Translation of Letter from Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.
No. 136 March 22. 1938.

Major Torrard,
Commissioner of Police,
S. M. P.

Sir,

According to a confidential report received stating that the local Communists have established an organization under the name of "Left Party Federation of China" (中國左翼文化總同盟) with its head office at 585 Changping Road near Gordon Road, in a room above the kitchen of "Sing Tai Siang" Electric Shop (新泰祥電汽行), under the charge of one Tsang Kwang Tseng (張光真), who is in possession of a large number of printed reactionary articles. Its branch office is at 570 Chen Yih Li (全益里) off Changping Road, the front room of the upper floor, under the charge of one Tsai ... (老曹). Acting upon the above information, a request was made to the Shanghai No. 1 Special District Court for the issue of a search warrant and your Special Branch were communicated with as well. After arrangements being made between Detective Inspector Ross and our staff, it was decided to carry out the search at 8.30 p.m., the same day, but it was suggested that we should approach the Gordon Road Station for assistance first. At the time appointed we proceeded to the Gordon Road Station where we accompanied by Foreign and Chinese detectives proceeded to 585 Changping Road where we arrested the communist Tsang Kwang Tseng, a native of Hunan, and seized a large number of reactionary literatures. We then proceeded to 570 Changping Road, where we succeeded in

（批：... 24/3）

先生，

据收到的机密报告称，当地共产党人已建立了一个名为“中国左翼文化总同盟”的组织，其总部设在戈登路附近的昌平路585号，“新泰祥电汽行”厨房楼上的房间内，由张光真（Tsang Kwang Tseng）负责，他拥有大量印刷的反动文章。其分部位于昌平路外的全益里（Chen Yih Li）570号，楼上前间，由曹...（老曹）负责。根据上述信息，向上海第一特别区法院申请签发搜查令，并也与贵处特别处进行了沟通。经侦探督察Ross与我方人员安排，决定于当晚8时30分进行搜查，但建议我们先向戈登路警署寻求协助。在约定时间，我们前往戈登路警署，随后在外籍和华籍侦探的陪同下前往昌平路585号，逮捕了湖南籍共产党人张光真，并查获大量反动文献。随后我们前往昌平路570号，成功

（批：Early）
（批：... 3月24日）

page_data.en:
- 2 -

effecting the arrest of Chang Tsung, Tung alias Lau Fan
(張宗順即老曹 ) and Chang Min Ching ( 張雲卿 ), both
natives of Szechuen, and also the seizure of a quantity
of literature of a similar nature. These persons arrested
were temporarily detained at the Gordon Road Station.
Men who were placed at the rendezvous to watch their
associates subsequently effected a further arrest named
Li Zhao Shu ( 李楚書 ). This man was also detained at
Gordon Road Station, who according to the Principal
Advocate's statement would be tried together with the
others previously arrested. Application has been made
for these persons to be handed over to us for investigation,
but the Court has set down the case for a special hearing.

I have to inform you that these persons were
arrested with sufficient evidence, and we are greatly
handicapped in proceeding further with the case unless
we could have them handed over to us. Apart from an
application being made to the Kiangsu Second Branch High
Court for their handing over, I shall be greatly obliged
if you can see your way to help us by communicating with
the Municipal Advocate to have these persons handed to
us as early as possible.

Yen Yin Ming,
Chief of Public Safety Bureau,
Shanghai.

- 2 -

逮捕了张宗顺即老曹（Chang Tsung, Tung alias Lau Fan）和张云卿（Chang Min Ching），两人均为四川籍，并查获了一批性质类似的宣传品。上述被捕人员暂时羁押于戈登路捕房。随后，部署在接头地点监视其同伙的警员又逮捕了一名名叫李楚书（Li Zhao Shu）的人。此人亦被羁押于戈登路捕房，据首席检察官陈述，他将与此前逮捕的其他人一并受审。已申请将这些人移交我方进行调查，但法院已将该案列为特别听证案件。

兹通知阁下，逮捕这些人时证据确凿，除非能将他们移交我方，否则我们在进一步处理此案时将受到极大阻碍。除了向江苏高等法院第二分院申请将他们移交外，如蒙阁下与市政检察官沟通，促使尽早将这些人移交我方，本人将不胜感激。

上海公安局局长
严寅铭

名为季楚书（Kyi Tsoo Su）的被告在捕房接受搜身时，被发现持有一张由戴春林成记（Tai Tsung Ling, ung Kee）香水店（未提及地址）盖章的租金收据。华探第266号在山西路的各家香水店进行了仔细查询，并在山西路256号找到了一家名为戴春林（Tai Tsung Ling）的香水店，从中获悉戴春林松记（Tai Tsung Ling Sung Kee）香水店位于曹家渡村。他前往该村，找到了香水店老板汪林生（Wang Nyi Zung），据称被告居住于极司菲尔路三义坊（Sai Nyi Paung）弄堂14号。华探第266号前往该地址，得知被告自1932年3月8日起租住一间后楼房间。

经检查，发现该房间内藏有共产主义宣传品，遂通知特科，侦探长切尔马汉斯基（Tchermahansky）赶赴现场，扣押了部分宣传品样本并带回总部进行审查。

中国左翼作家联盟.
反对意图“瓜分”中国的国际联盟调查委员会宣言.
全国反日革命的民众们！
帝国主义的掠夺分配机构——由国联专门派遣来瓜分中国领土的国际联盟调查委员会，最近已抵达上海，连日来，上海的中国政府官员、买办、资本家以及教育机构的走狗们正忙于日夜宴请委员会成员。街道上随处可见写有“欢迎”和“拥护”字样的海报，仿佛他们是世界上唯一的救星？
调查委员会抵达已有数日，他们做了什么调查工作？他们宣称“上海最近的战争是一次不幸的事件，谁应为这一事件负责目前尚不可预知，但日本确实遭受了某种‘扰乱’，因此派遣军队至上海。中国商人应立即重新开店营业并保持安静！”这就是他们的所作所为。既然他们宣称上海战争是“动荡”和反日运动的结果，如果我们想摆脱战争，就必须保持安静。这显然意味着我们应该安静地等待日本的屠杀，同时等待英、美、法、意帝国主义对上海的“共同统治和瓜分”。
所有外国国家都在我们的重要城市派遣了领事，他们想要调查什么？哪个国家不知道中日敌对状态及其原因？他们调查此事的目的是：-(1) 为了

7

page_data.en:
-2-
calm the Chinese multitude in their anti-Japanese movements,
so as to leave enough time for the robber-like Imperialists
to share Chinese territory, (2) to give a chance to the Kouming-
tang to oppress the anti-Japanese multitude, so as to have an
opportunity to "sell" all the privilege belonging to the people,
(3) The more vivid inquiry they make at present, the more privi-
lege the Imperialistic nations will have from China in future.
Has the fact placed before you all, that on one part they want
China to open peace negotiations but on the other part they
allow the Japanese aeroplanes to spy the internal cities such
as Soochow and Hangchow, and simultaneously reinforcements have
been despatched on the Shanghai-Nanking Railways lines, and Man-
of wars cruised into the Chinese coasts. The Koumintang has
pretended to ask Japan to withdraw their troop, but at the same
time its own army has evacuated bravely to the region of Soochow
and Dsangchow and also bravely has despatched the traitorus state
sman Dr. Willington Koo to attend the peace conference.
The multitude! the League Inquiry Commision members
are the butchers' knives of the Imperialists which shall share
China's territory into pieces, they are also the smoke-bombs of
the Japanese, therefore we should emancipate ourselves from the
gun-shells and aeroplane bombs from the Imperialists. The only
way to struggle is to persevere to the end the anti-Japanese
movement, to execute entire revolutionary struggle for the nation
We must arm ourselves and overthrow the traitors who are trying
to sell our people's privilege, and overthrow the Koumingtang and
then establish a Soviet Government.
Oust the International League Commission members from our ter-
ritory!
The Multitude should rise up and arm themselves so as to strug-
gle for the anti-Japan war to the every end!
Overthrow the traitorous Koumingtang who are trying to sell
the privilge of the Shanghai people & the whole nation!
Establish our own anti Imperialistic Soviet Government!
18/3/32.

-2-
平息中国民众的反日运动，以便给强盗般的帝国主义留出足够的时间来瓜分中国领土，(2) 给国民党一个压迫反日民众的机会，以便有机会“出卖”属于人民的所有特权，(3) 他们现在进行的调查越生动，帝国主义国家将来从中国获得的特权就越多。
事实摆在你们面前，一方面他们希望中国开启和平谈判，另一方面却允许日本飞机侦察苏州和杭州等内陆城市，同时援军已通过沪宁铁路线派遣，军舰巡航至中国沿海。国民党假装要求日本撤军，但其军队却勇敢地撤退到苏州和常州地区，并勇敢地派遣卖国贼顾维钧博士（Dr. Willington Koo）参加和平会议。
民众们！国联调查委员会成员是帝国主义瓜分中国领土的屠刀，也是日本的烟幕弹，因此我们应该从帝国主义的炮弹和飞机炸弹中解放自己。唯一的斗争方式是坚持反日运动到底，进行彻底的民族革命斗争。我们必须武装自己，推翻试图出卖人民特权的卖国贼，推翻国民党，建立苏维埃政府。
将国际联盟委员会成员赶出我们的领土！
民众应奋起武装自己，为反日战争奋斗到底！
推翻试图出卖上海人民及全国人民特权的卖国国民党！
建立我们自己的反帝苏维埃政府！

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Kyi Tsoo Su.
native of Wusin, taken by me made by himself.
translated
at G. P. Sqn., on the 18/3/32. and interpreted by Lao Chien.

My name is Kyi Tsoo Su (李楚書), alias Loh Ying (洛英).
age 25 years, native of Wusin. I was graduated from Chi U Uni-
versity. In 1930, I was recommended by my friend, Mr. Mau Cheun
Bin (毛潤白), to work as an editor of Kowling Dau Pau,
in Wusin, with wages $25.00. a month. In November, 1930, Mr. Mau
was pointed the committee of Changchow City Koumingtang Headquar-
ters and asked me to act the editor of Chung San Daily News in
Changchow with wages $30.00. a month. In June 1931, I returned
to my native place. Last month my friend, Wong Y.h Hing (王一鳴),
recommended me to act the teacher in Dah Chung Middle School, in
Boulnion Road, so I came to Shanghai on the 16/3/32. I stayed
with my friend, Yau Bah Keh (姚伯凱), in Ching Loong Co. (靖隆公司)
Ssecheun Road, and Yu Sz Sing (余四新), in C.H.&Co. He said
to me that my school mate, Leung Kwang Tseng (張光貞), was
residing at 385 Changping Road, and I might go to this place to
see him. In this afternoon, I was calling upon this address and
arrested. This is a true statement.

Kyi Tsoo Su. (Signed).

我叫李楚书（Kyi Tsoo Su），别名洛英（Loh Ying）。现年25岁，吴兴人。我毕业于齐鲁大学。1930年，经朋友毛润白（Mau Cheun Bin）推荐，我在吴兴担任《九龙日报》编辑，月薪25.00元。1930年11月，毛先生被任命为常州国民党市党部委员，并聘我担任常州《中山日报》编辑，月薪30.00元。1931年6月，我返回原籍。上月，我的朋友王一鸣（Wong Y.h Hing）推荐我到北四川路的大同中学任教，于是我于1932年3月16日来到上海。我借住在四川路靖隆公司的朋友姚伯凯（Yau Bah Keh）和余四新（Yu Sz Sing）处。余四新告诉我，我的同学张光贞（Leung Kwang Tseng）住在昌平路385号，我可以去那里见他。当天下午，我前往该地址拜访时被捕。以上供述属实。

SECRET -- NOT FOR PRESS PUBLICATION
MUNICIPAL POLICE (SPECIAL BRANCH) INTELLIGENCE SUMMARY - 18/3/32

1 Raids on Communist Bases - Seizure of literature - 3 arrests
Acting on the authority of warrants issued by the Shanghai
Special District Court at the instance of the Public Safety
Bureau, the Municipal Police during the evening of March 17
raided 385 Changping Road and 370 Changping Road, and seized at
both places a large quantity of communist literature of recent date
some of which bears on the Anniversary of March 18 (Paris
Commune). At the first named address, a student named Tsang
Kwong-chen (張光真) was arrested and as a result of a watch
maintained on the latter premises, two students named Tsang Tsong-
zung (張宗縱) and Tsang Yung-ching (張永清) were apprehended
while entering the building. The three accused will appear before
Court on March 18 when an application for their extradition will
be made by the Chinese Authorities.

According to information received, 385 Changping Road was
the headquarters of a newly organized communist association known
as the "Left Wing Cultural League", while the other address was
used as its branch office.

2. Cantonese Fellow Countrymen' Association - Temporary Office
established
A temporary office under the charge of Chen Hung-nien (陳洪年)
Ex-Vice Minister of Industry, Teng Shao-san (鄧少山) and others,
was established on March 17 at No.94A Nanchwang Road. The object
of this association is to give relief to Cantonese refugees in
Shanghai, obtain employment for unemployed Cantonese and afford
help towards school expenses of poor children, etc.

3. National Salvation Committee to Resist Japan (defunct) - Gratuity
to staff employees
Between 1 p.m. and 5.20 p.m. March 17, about 140 former staff
employees of the defunct National Salvation Committee to Resist
Japan were given $5.50 each by a committee member in the Hwei
Ning Fellow Countrymen's Association, No. 21, Lane 75, Sinza Road.
This money is part proceeds of fines imposed for the release of
seized goods. Payments to other members of the staff will be
continued to-day, March 18.

工部局警务处（特务科）情报摘要 - 1932年3月18日

1 突袭共产主义据点 - 查获文献 - 3人被捕
根据上海特区法院应公安局请求签发的逮捕令授权，工部局警察于3月17日晚突袭了昌平路385号和昌平路370号，并在两处查获了大量近期的共产主义文献，其中一些涉及纪念三月十八日（巴黎公社）。在第一个地址，一名名叫张光真（Tsang Kwong-chen）的学生被捕；由于对后一处住所进行了监视，两名名叫张宗纵（Tsang Tsong-zung）和张永清（Tsang Yung-ching）的学生在进入大楼时被抓获。三名被告将于3月18日出庭，届时中国当局将申请引渡他们。

据收到的消息，昌平路385号是新成立的名为“左翼文化联盟”的共产主义协会的总部，而另一地址则用作其分部办公室。

2. 广东同乡会 - 设立临时办事处
由前实业部次长陈洪年、邓少山等人负责的临时办事处于3月17日在南昌路94A号成立。该协会的宗旨是救济在上海的广东难民，为失业的广东人寻找工作，并资助贫困儿童的学费等。

3. 抗日救国会（已解散） - 向职员发放抚恤金
3月17日下午1点至5点20分之间，约140名已解散的抗日救国会前职员在新闸路75弄21号的徽宁同乡会，从一名委员会成员处每人领取了5.50美元。这笔钱部分来自没收物品释放罚款所得。对其他职员的付款将于今日（3月18日）继续发放。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Tsang Kwang Cheng(張光真 ).
native of Anhwo, Human . taken by me C.D.C.176.
at G.R.Stn. on the 17/3/32 and interpreted by translated Interpreter Chien.

My name is Tsang Kwang Cheng(張光真 ), male Chinese, age 19 years,
and I am a native of the Siau Yee Tsung Village in the Anhwo Hsien
(安化縣小淹村), Hunan Province. I am unmarried and I live at 385
Changping Road, an upstairs back room. When I was 9 years old, I join-
ed the Wuchang No.4 Primary School, Hupeh Province. In the Year 16th
of the Chinese Republic, I joined the Wuchang No.1 Middle School.
After the summer vacation of the 18th Year of Chinese Republic I
came to Shanghai and later joined the Lau Tung College (Labour Uni-
versity), Kiangwan. I only studied in the Middle School of this
University. After the Winter Vacation last year, I returned to Hankow
in the month of December, intending to borrow some money from my
relative and friends, but failed to get any money from them. I re-
turned to Shanghai in January, 1932, and lived in the Yee Dai Middle
School, Markham Road. I only stayed there for a short period, when
I met one of my school mates of the Labour University, named Yang
Lui Ching (楊柳青), age about 20 years, native of Kompo, who intro-
duced me to his friend named Wong who asked me to assist him in
packing up and posting the "China & The World" magazine. I obtained
a monthly pay of $20. for this job. I lived at the upstairs back
room at 385 Changping Road since the middle of January, 1932. The
rent for this room was $7.00 a month. All the magazines were sent
to my address by the man Wong. I received my wages from him also.
I have no relatives in Shanghai. I have never been charged or con-
victed before. I know nothing more than what I have stated above.

Tsang Kwang Cheng
(Signed & finger printed)

Witness C.D.C.176.

警务调查报告。

以下为安徽、湖南籍人张光真（Tsang Kwang Cheng）之供词，由本人（刑事侦缉队员176号）于1932年3月17日在戈登路巡捕房录取，并由翻译员钱氏翻译。

我叫张光真（Tsang Kwang Cheng），男，华人，现年19岁，籍贯湖南省安化县小淹村。我未婚，居住在昌平路385号楼上后间。我9岁时考入湖北省武昌第四小学。民国十六年，我考入武昌第一中学。民国十八年暑假后，我来到上海，随后考入江湾劳动大学。我只在该大学的中学部就读。去年寒假后，我于十二月返回汉口，打算向亲友借钱，但未能借到任何款项。我于1932年1月返回上海，住在马克姆路（Markham Road，即今黄陂北路附近）的义达中学。我只在那里住了很短一段时间，遇到了一位劳动大学的校友，名叫杨柳青（Yang Lui Ching），约20岁，高邮人，他把我介绍给他的朋友王某，让我协助他打包和邮寄《中国与世界的》杂志。我做这份工作每月获得20.00元报酬。自1932年1月中旬以来，我一直住在昌平路385号楼上后间。该房间租金为每月7.00元。所有杂志均由王某寄到我的地址。我也从他那里领取工资。我在上海没有亲戚。我以前从未被指控或定罪。除上述陈述外，我一无所知。

张光真
（签名并按指印）

见证人 刑事侦缉队员176号。

List of communist literature seized during a raid on No.385
Changping Road at 8.45 p.m. March 17, 1932. (one arrest)

1. Handbill entitled "Manifesto on the Anniversary of March 18th
(Paris Commune), purporting to have emanated from the Chinese
Left Wing Cultural League", urging labourers, peasants
and toiling masses throughout the country to arm themselves,
to overthrow the Kuomintang administration and establish a
people's Soviet Political power. 60 copies.

2. Handbill entitled "The 4th General Meeting of Representatives
of the Chinese Left Wing Cultural League" containing a circular
telegram addressed to the proletariat and the oppressed people
throughout the world exhorting them to support firmly the
anti-Japanese War and to oppose the attack on Soviet Russia
and the Chinese Red armies. 35 copies.

3. Handbill entitled "Manifesto issued by the Chinese Left Wing
Cultural League, opposing the retreat of Chinese troops from
Shanghai by the compulsory order of the Kuomintang militarists"
urging labourers, peasants and soldiers to overthrow Japanese
Imperialists, to kill Chinese traitors and members of various
cliques of the Kuomintang, to organize a Revolutionary Military
Committee and to persevere in the Anti-Imperialist war.
5 copies

4. Journal entitled "China and the World", containing the
following articles :
a) The American Left Wing Cultural Class oppose
International Imperialism.
b) The partition of China and the Attack on Soviet Russia.
1,000 copies

5. Journal entitled "Eastern Youth" containing articles on
"The Anniversary of the International Women's Day (March 8)",
"Unite the fireline of students and expel their bad elements",
"Self declaration of Sze Chung Tung", etc.
54 copies

6. Journal entitled "Justice" containing articles on the students
movement of national salvation, the boycott of Japanese goods,
the severance of economic relations with Japan during China's
national crisis. 198 copies

7. Booklet entitled "Disorderly Bell" written in the style of
a novel relating the Sino-Japanese conflict.
450 copies.

8. Journal entitled "Literary Guide" containing an article on
the 14th anniversary of the Soviet Revolution and the
establishment of the Central Provisional Government of
Chinese Soviet Republic. 1 copy.

9. Mosquito paper entitled "China and the World", dated 12.2.32,
containing articles on the attack of Shanghai by Japanese
Imperialists, labour news in the Western district and
operations of the Red Army in Hupeh.
1,000 copies.

10 Mimeographed draft entitled "Discussion on the Sino-
Japanese conflict in Shanghai".
5 copies.

1932年3月17日晚9时，特别处警佐 Makaroff 会同公安局官员，持特区地方法院第4088号搜查逮捕令，并在警佐 Nancarrow 及华籍侦探 176号和324号的陪同下，突袭了昌平路370号 premises。在对楼上的一间前屋进行搜查时，查获藏在几个抽屉里的大量共产主义文献。戈登路捕房的侦探和公安局官员对该处所进行了监视，随后在上述被告进入该处所时将其逮捕。特别处所需的所有文件副本已由警佐 Makaroff 获取。被告已被相应起诉，并将于1932年3月18日出庭受审于特区地方法院，届时公安局代表将向法庭申请，在庭审后将被告移交给中国当局。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Tsang Tsung Zung(張宗順).
native of Chengtu, Szechuen. taken by me C.D.C.176.
at G.R.Stn. on the 17/3/32 and interpreted by Interpreter Chien.

My name is Tsang Tsung Zung, male Chinese, age 18 years, and I am a native of Chengtu, Szechuen Province. My home in Chengtu is No.9 Yih Tuh Lee Hwa Sing Tung Kah(益德里華興東街), Chengtu. I am now living the Yee Dai Middle School Premises, Avenue Haig and Route Ferguson corner. When I was 8 years of age, I joined the Chengtu Primary School, Chengtu, and when 12 years old, I was transferred to the Chengtu Middle School (also in Chengtu). On the 11th of January, 1932, I came to Shanghai for the purpose of furthering my study but as the present trouble has not been settled, I have not made up my mind to join which school, and as I have not obtained any money from my home, I cannot join the school. I live at the premises of Yee Dai School, for this school supports the student from the war suffering areas and furnish dormitory etc. I have not joined any political party. About 7 p.m. 17/3/32, I left the Yee Dai School and proceeded to 370 Changping Road intending to borrow some money from my friend named Zau Dih Chu(曹狄秋) living in that address, but I was arrested, and I was found in possession of a booklet called "Deon Lee" and some letters. I borrow this book from a man named Lieu Yee Zung(刘以順) at the Universal Printing Co.(神州國光社) I knew nothing about other affairs.

Tsang Tsung Zung
(Signed & finger printed)

Police witness C.D.C.176.

以下为张宗顺 (Tsang Tsung Zung) 的供词，
四川成都人，由我（华籍侦探176号）于1932年3月17日
在戈登路捕房录取，并由翻译钱君口译。

我叫张宗顺，男性，华人，18岁，籍贯四川省成都市。我在成都的住址是益德里华兴东街9号。我现在住在海格路与福开森路转角处的义大中学宿舍内。我8岁时进入成都小学读书，12岁时转入成都中学（也在成都）。1932年1月11日，我来上海是为了继续求学，但由于目前的战乱尚未平息，我尚未决定加入哪所学校，而且因为家中未寄钱来，我无法入学。我住在义大中学的校舍内，因为该校收容来自战区的流亡学生并提供宿舍等。我没有加入任何政党。1932年3月17日晚7点左右，我离开义大中学，前往昌平路370号，打算向住在那里的朋友曹狄秋 (Zau Dih Chu) 借些钱，但我被捕了，并且被发现持有一本名为《理论》(Deon Lee) 的小册子和一些信件。这本书是我从神州国光社一个叫刘以顺 (Lieu Yee Zung) 的人那里借来的。我对其他事情一无所知。

张宗顺
(签名并按指印)

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Tsang Yuin Ching(張云卿).
native of Szechuen taken by me C.D.C. 324.
at G.R.Stn. on the 17/3/32 translated and interpreted by Interpreter Chien.

My name is Tsang Yuin Ching(張云卿) male Chinese, single student, age 23 years and I am a native of Szechuen. I lived in the Tsung Foo Street, Chengtu previous, but now I live at Yee Dai Middle School premises, Avenue Haig and Route Forguson, on the second floor. I came to Shanghai on the 20th March, 1932., and lived at No.1 Ling Sung Fong Paoshan Road, Chapei. Owing to the Sino Japan war I removed my belongings to the Yee Dai Middle School. In the August 20th Year of Chinese Republic, I tried to join the Public College of China(中国公学), but I did not pass the entrance examination, so I studied at my home. I am not connected in any school at present. About 9 p.m. on the 17/3/32 I went to 370 Zee Yih Li, Changping Road for the purpose of sending a letter to my friend Zau Chu Yih(曹狄秋), when I was arrested. I have no relatives in Shanghai and I have not been charged before.

Tsang Yuin Ching
(Signed & finger printed)

Police witness C.D.C. 324.

我叫张云卿 (張云卿)，男性，华人，单身，学生，23岁，籍贯四川。我以前住在成都总府街，但现在住在海格路与福开森路义大中学宿舍的二楼。我于1932年3月20日来到上海，住在闸北宝山路林松坊1号。由于中日战争，我将行李搬到了义大中学。民国二十年八月，我曾试图报考中国公学，但未通过入学考试，因此在家自学。目前我没有在任何学校就读。1932年3月17日晚9点左右，我去昌平路积义里370号，目的是给我的朋友曹狄秋 (Zau Chu Yih) 寄一封信，当时我被捕。我在上海没有亲属，此前也未曾被指控过。

张云卿
(签名并按指印)

Proceedings. Mr. Lea appeared for the Police.
Mr. Lea:- At 9.p.m. on the 17/3/32 the Special Branch and detectives with a representative of the P.S.B. armed with a Search Warrant raided No. 385 Changping Rd to arrest Bai Tsang, Tsang Kweng Chung and two others. This accused was arrested and a quantity of literature was seized (produced). The information was supplied by the P.S.B. and the accuse arrested by the Police. The P. .B. cannot produce sufficient evidence, so the Police charged the accused accordingly, in this Court
C.D.C. 324:- Corroborated and added. When we went to arrest the accused the room was locked and the accused was not there. We broke a window to enter the premises and seized some communistic literature.
I waited downstairs for the accused, and after about 10 minutes, the accused came in, and when I questioned him he stated that he lived in the room. He was going to enter the room at the time and he told me that his name was Tsang Kwung Cheng so I arrested him.
Accused in answer to Judge :- The books seized were given to me by my friend to read. I had no money, so I wrote home to my parents and I received a reply that they would send me some. I live at 385 Changping Rd. A man named "Wong" asked me to work for him to deliver books to the Post Office. This literature seized, was in a basket. I have only read a few pages of the books, so I do not know the full contents Some of these books were lent to me by a man named "Yang" the others belong to "Tseng".
Rep. of P.S.B. Lieu tha:- I request that the accused be handed over to us. The accused is a communist because the books found in his room are of a communist nature.

指控 危害国家安全罪。违反《惩治危害民国罪犯条例》第二条第二款及第六条。
指控其于1932年3月17日晚9时在昌平路385号被查获持有大量共产主义及反政府文献。

诉讼过程。 Lea 先生代表警方出庭。
Lea 先生：- 1932年3月17日晚9时，特别处警探会同公安局代表，持搜查令突袭昌平路385号，以逮捕 Bai Tsang、Tsang Kweng Chung 及其他两人。本案被告被捕，并查获大量文献（呈堂）。情报由公安局提供，被告由警方逮捕。公安局无法提供充分证据，故警方据此在本法庭对被告提起诉讼。
华籍侦探 324号：- 证实上述情况并补充道。当我们去逮捕被告时，房间门锁着，被告不在里面。我们打破窗户进入室内，查获了一些共产主义文献。
我在楼下等候被告，大约10分钟后，被告进来，当我讯问他时，他说他住在这个房间里。他当时正要进房间，并告诉我他叫 Tsang Kwung Cheng，于是我便逮捕了他。
被告回答法官问：- 查获的书籍是我的朋友给我看的。我没有钱，所以写信回家给父母，收到回信说他们会寄钱给我。我住在昌平路385号。一个叫“Wong”的人让我帮他工作，把书送到邮局。这些被查获的文献装在一个篮子里。我只读了几页书，所以不知道全部内容。其中一些书是一个叫“Yang”的人借给我的，其他的属于“Tseng”。
公安局代表 Lieu tha：- 我请求将被告移交给我们。被告是共产党员，因为在他房间里发现的书具有共产主义性质。

他们已在此案关联中逮捕了其他人，我建议
将那些被捕者带至本法庭，以证明今晨在庭的

WEB.

in the pants pocket at first & they must have slipped down in to my
trousers. They were given to me by one named Yih Ding Fong, he
lived in French Town & he told me to give the papers to a man named
Lieu living in the Yu Ding Fong off Ferry Rd, I did not read the pap
ers when they were given to me. I knew Lieu when I was a teacher
at the Gee Nyoeh college. I lived then with a relative in the Lee
Tseng Ku in the Native City.
Mr. Lea:- This is also a paper found in accused's note book
( handed to court). & it gives an idea the numbers of pamphlets to
various pupils, but the address's are not clear.
Judge to accused:- These papers prove that you were in
Shanghai before the 15/3/32.
Accused:- I was previously a teacher at the college & owing
to the Sino Japanese trouble in Shanghai I left here & then returned
again. My relative named Goe Sei Ling works at No, 95 Carter Rd,
this lace is called the " World students Federation". I lived at
No,26 Jai Ing Fong alleyway after I left the " Gee Nyoeh College".
I left the house in Ferry Rd, on the 10/3/32 & went to say with a
relative. On the 6/3 I went to my home in the country & returned
here on the 10th, My uncle can prove that I went home on the 6th,

Lea 先生：- 这也是在被告笔记本中发现的一张纸（呈交法庭）。它显示了分发给各个学生的宣传册数量，但地址不清楚。

Mr T S Lea appeared for the Police.
Mr Lung Vung Ka appointed for the accused.

Judge to Mr Lea :- I will only hear the case of the 2nd and
3rd accused, as the other two were tried by another Judge.

Mr Lea :- At 9.p.m on the 17th of last month, the Public
Safety Bureau went to Gordon Road Station with a warrant, and asked
for assistance to go to No.370 Changping Road, where they stated
they had received information that some Communists were there. The
necessary assistance was rendered, and when they entered these
premises, two persons were arrested and some books seized, and in
the possession of the 2nd accused, a certificate bearing the name
of a man named "Tsun" was found, but the 2nd accused stated it was
not him. The Police then asked him to make a statement, and he
wrote down his proper name "Tsun" first, and then altered it to
"Tsung". The 2nd accused is really the man "Tsun", and a representa-
tive is here this afternoon, to ask for the handing over of the two
accused, but the Police want them first to prove they committed
crimes outside of the Settlement, before they are handed over.

C.D.C.524 :- Corroborated.

Witness Wong Ping :- I am a representative of the Public
Safety Bureau. These two accused were implicated by other prisoners
in another case, and that is how we received the information. We then
applied for a warrant and had them arrested. There were some pamph-
lets found in the City on the 18th of last month, and are similar
to those which we found in the house at No.370 Changping Road, and
this is the reason we are asking for the two accused to be handed
over.

Judge to witness Wong Ping :- This case cannot be handed over
as it is already being tried by this Court, and I have already in-
formed the Public Safety Bureau to this effect.

Witness Wong Ping :- I can prove that these two accused did
live in the house by the tenants. The name of the man we received
in the City was "Lan Tsun", and the 2nd accused is the man wanted.

诉讼
T S Lea 先生代表警方出庭。
Lung Vung Ka 先生受委任为被告辩护。

法官对 Lea 先生说：- 我只审理第2和第3被告的案件，因为另外两人已由另一位法官审讯。

Lea 先生：- 上月17日晚9时，市公安局持 warrant 来到戈登路警局，请求协助前往昌平路370号，他们称收到情报称那里有一些共产党人。警方提供了必要的协助，当他们进入该处所时，逮捕了两名人员并查获了一些书籍，在第2被告身上发现了一张印有名为“Tsun”的男子姓名的证书，但第2被告声称那不是他。随后警方要求他做陈述，他先写下了真名“Tsun”，然后改为“Tsung”。第2被告确实是“Tsun”这个人，今天下午有一名代表前来，要求移交这两名被告，但警方希望他们首先证明在租界外犯了罪，然后再予移交。

C.D.C.524：- 证实。

证人 Wong Ping：- 我是市公安局的代表。这两名被告因另一案件中的其他囚犯供出而受牵连，我们由此获得情报。随后我们申请了逮捕令并将他们逮捕。上月18日在南市发现了一些宣传册，与我们在昌平路370号房屋内发现的类似，这就是我们要求移交这两名被告的原因。

法官对证人 Wong Ping 说：- 此案不能移交，因为本院正在审理，我已就此通知市公安局。

证人 Wong Ping：- 我可以证明这两名被告确实住在那所房子里，这是通过租户得知的。我们在南市收到的名字是“Lan Tsun”，第2被告就是被通缉的人。

Witness Zung Ah Sz :- I am the wife of Zung Wah Ling who is
the chief tenant of the house at No.370 Changning Road. He rented
a room to the two accused, and the 3rd accused paid the rent. The
room was rented in the 12th moon, and both the accused had lived
there for two months. They always left in the morning, and returned
about 4.p.m. I do not know if they had any friends visiting them
or not, as I paid no attention to them. They said they were students.
Sometimes they had friends visiting them. I do not know if they
held any meetings or not. They occupied the upstairs front room,
and the upstairs rear room was let to someone else. They did not
tell me their names when they came to hire the room. We do not re-
port to the police when a new family moves into the house, and they
do not give any guarantees. There was another man named "Tsau"
but he is not here this afternoon. At first the man Tsau and the
2nd accused came to rent the room, and owing to the recent trouble,
Tsau ran away, and then these two accused who are brothers occupied
the room. The photo on this certificate (handed to witness by the
Judge) is that of the 2nd accused. When Tsau left the house, he
took away all his belongings and he has never returned. The room
is now occupied by these two accused.

Witness Foo Tsao Tsung :- I am a representative of the Public
Safety Bureau. I received information that the two accused were
Communists and were living in Changping Road, so we obtained assis-
tance from the Settlement Police and arrested them. I ask the
Court to hand them over to us for investigations, and after the
investigations have been completed, we will return them back to this
Court.
Judge to witness Foo Tsao Tsung :- They cannot be handed over
to the Public Safety Bureau, as this Court is already trying the
case.
2nd accused :- My name is Tsang and not Tsau. The other man
named Tsau was my brother, and he was adopted out of the family, and
changed his name.

证人 Zung Ah Sz：- 我是 Zung Wah Ling 的妻子，他是昌宁路370号房屋的主租户。他将一个房间租给了两名被告，第3被告支付了租金。房间是在农历十二月租下的，两名被告已在那里住了两个月。他们总是早上离开，下午4点左右回来。我不知道是否有朋友拜访他们，因为我没有注意他们。他们说自己是学生。有时有朋友拜访他们。我不知道他们是否举行过集会。他们占用楼上前面的房间，楼上后面的房间租给了别人。他们来租房时没有告诉我他们的名字。当新家庭搬入房屋时，我们不向警方报告，他们也不提供任何担保。还有另一个名为“Tsau”的人，但他今天下午不在。起初是 Tsau 和第2被告来租房，由于最近的动荡，Tsau 逃走了，然后这两名兄弟被告占用了该房间。这张证书上的照片（由法官出示给证人）是第2被告的。当 Tsau 离开房子时，他带走了所有财物，再也没有回来。现在这个房间由这两名被告占用。

证人 Foo Tsao Tsung：- 我是市公安局的代表。我收到情报称这两名被告是共产党人，住在昌平路，因此我们获得租界警方的协助并将他们逮捕。我请求法庭将他们移交给我们要进行调查，调查结束后，我们将把他们退回本法庭。

诉讼过程 - Len 先生代表警方出庭。
" " Ching Yung Keh 由法庭指派为被告辩护。
Len 先生：- 概述了指控及案情，如同上次听证会所述；并补充说，第一被告做了一份陈述，并自称为“Zau”。随后他立即将其改为另一个名字。上海市公安局（S.P.S.S）要求将被告移交给他们，但他们没有证据表明他在闸北地区犯有任何罪行。他们是在租界内因持有共产主义文献而被捕的。
第一被告：- 我父亲有两个儿子，我父亲与一个叫“Zau”的人是朋友，他收养了我，所以我取了“Zau”这个名字。我知道那些共产主义书籍，但我并不住在被捕的那所房子里。第二被告不是我的兄弟。我去见“Zau”时认识了第二被告。房东在第一次听证会上说我不住在昌平路370号，我不认识那个提供针对我信息的姓杨的人，我也没有从他那里收到任何小册子。
此处向被告宣读了杨的陈述。
第一被告：- 我不是共产党人，如果我是，杨可以来法庭与我对质。他应该认识我。我没有把任何小册子交给杨奇（Yang Chi）。
第二被告：- 我不认识第一被告。我去昌平路370号是为了见“Zau”并向他借点钱。我不住在那里。我对在房子里发现的小册子一无所知。房东说我住在那里是在撒谎。第一被告不是我的兄弟。我不叫小曹（Siau Tsau）。我不认识杨奇。为什么杨不来法庭与我对质指控？

Date 11 / 5 / 32.

Proceedings.
Mr T.S.Lea appeared for the Police
Mr Yao Ding Kwong appeared for the accused.

Mr Lea :- On the 18th March this year at 3.20.p.m, the accused was arrested at No.385 Changping Road. This case is connected with another case where a man named Tsang Kwang Tsung was previously arrested in these premises, and after his arrest, a detective was posted on the premises, and later this accused came and was arrested. The police also found out that this accused has an alias Loh Ying, and when he was arrested, in his possession was found a draft of a Communistic nature, and from the rent received, the police also found out that the accused rented a room at No.14 Jessfield Road on the 18th March this year. The other man named Tseng Kwang Tsung was arrested on behalf of the Public Safety Bureau, and as they know more about this case than we do, I ask the Court if it is necessary to remand the case in order to get the evidence from the Public Safety Bureau.

Judge :- It is not necessary.

Accused :- I was arrested at 3.30.p.m on the 18th March. I went to No.385 Changping Road to meet Tsang Kwang Tsung in order to have my sister enrolled in school. That was the first time I went there. I do not know if these premises were used by Communists for propaganda. When I was in the bookstall, I met a school mate named Yi Ling Feng, and he gave me a letter and asked me to take it to a house in the Foo Ding Fong alleyway off Wuting Road. He wanted me to give it to a man named Lien. The envelope was not sealed, and I do not know what was the contents of it. I do not think I can find Yi now, but I think I can find the man named Lien, who lives in the upstairs room of the 3rd house in the Foo Ding Fong alleyway off Wuting Road. Yi was a school mate of mine in the Tsinan University.

Judge :- I will remand your case pending enquiries at the Tsinan University.

Mr Lea :- Some books were found in the accused's premises, and I ask the Court to dispose of them.

Lea 先生：- 今年3月18日下午3点20分，被告在昌平路385号被捕。本案与另一起案件有关，该案中一名叫曾广宗（Tsang Kwang Tsung）的男子此前在同一地点被捕，在他被捕后，一名侦探被部署在该地点监视，随后这名被告前来并被捕。警方还查出这名被告有一个别名罗英（Loh Ying），在他被捕时，身上搜出了一份具有共产主义性质的草稿，并且从收到的租金中，警方还查出被告于今年3月18日租下了极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）14号的一个房间。另一名男子曾广宗是代表公安局被捕的，由于他们比我们更了解此案，我询问法庭是否有必要将案件还押，以便从公安局获取证据。

法官：- 没有必要。

被告：- 我是在3月18日下午3点30分被捕的。我去昌平路385号是为了见曾广宗，以便让我的妹妹入学。那是我第一次去那里。我不知道这些地方是否被共产党用于宣传。我在书摊时，遇到了一位名叫易凌峰（Yi Ling Feng）的同学，他给了我一封信，让我把它带到武定路附近的福定坊（Foo Ding Fong）巷子里的一所房子里。他想让我把它交给一个叫连（Lien）的人。信封没有封口，我不知道里面的内容是什么。我想我现在找不到易了，但我想我能找到那个叫连的人，他住在武定路附近福定坊巷子第三栋房子的楼上房间。易是我在济南大学的同学。

法官：- 我将把你的案件还押，以待在济南大学进行调查。

Lea 先生：- 在被告的住处发现了一些书籍，我请求法庭处理这些书籍。

the 17/3/32 at 370 Changping Rd. The room was not hired by me. The

twins and my father had a good friend who had no sons so my brother

李（Lea）先生：警务处代表未出庭，因此我们无从询问他是否在南市发生了任何犯罪行为。我请求法庭获取警务处向地方法院提交的申请书，以查看申请内容。如果警方因涉及两名被告而在南市实施了逮捕，警方对此移交并无异议；如果在租界内未发生此类性质的犯罪，我们也无异议。
第一被告回答法官问：我于1932年3月17日晚9点在昌平路370号被捕。该房间并非由我租赁。所发现的证件是我兄弟的财产。我和我兄弟是双胞胎，我父亲有一位好友没有儿子，所以我兄弟过继给他做儿子，这就是我兄弟名字不同的原因。我在供词上写错名字是因为遭受刑讯而紧张所致。我对共产主义书籍一无所知。我不是国民党或共产党成员。
第二被告：我从未居住在昌平路370号。我刚到那所房子时就被捕了。我去那里是为了向“Zau” Dih Tsu（音译）借钱。我没有向警务处承认我住在那里。我对在房间里发现的共产主义书籍等物一无所知。我不是任何党派的成员。
（此时代表们出庭。）
警务处代表刘沙（Lieu Sha，音译）：我们收到情报称昌平路370号被共产党用作集会地点。在警方的协助下，我们搜查了该处所。我们收到情报称一名叫“Lau Zau”（音译）的人住在那里。警方逮捕了这两名被告，并从房间内查获一张照片，我们发现其中一名被告就是通缉犯，因为照片与第一被告相貌相符。他在签署供词时签的是“Zau”。我们讯问了该房屋的总租客，他表示房间是由“Zau”租赁的，并证实第二被告居住在那里。
